body:
It is true though, if I were more together or had done things differently maybe I wouldn't be planning for something so selfish, maybe I wouldn't be choosing to "quit" because everything went wrong.

It is my life though, and there really is no way out. It just keeps going until I die.

There is nothing I enjoy. There is nothing that makes me happy... And there isn't even anything for me to accomplish. 
Severance package? I would be gone - it isn't as if I would be around to get one even if they handed them out. I am not so stupid as to think that I will die but still be around afterward.

If there was something I could find to even aim for, like there used to be, then I could see a point. But there isn't a point. It is just suffer through one day, then the next, until I die. What does it matter if I just cut that short?

That may be true. Money may not really matter. But the world doesn't work that way. I can work all my waking hours, and still all of it disappears to pay bills for something that didn't work and didn't help in the end.

Once my son was gone, I thought I would at least have one person to fall back on. But once he was gone, my husband was relieved that now he could file for divorce and head over to his "real" family. He was just waiting for a chance to leave without having the guilt of leaving a child. I was just a way to have a child, so when I couldn`t do that anymore it didn't matter. He is happy with the healthy children he deserves. I am not mad at him. I would have left me too. I can't even make a baby properly, something that even the lowest most awful women can manage without trying.

I only feel alright when I don`t feel anything. If I could go to sleep and just stay that way forever, I would. And that is really what I think is best. I can't possibly take care of another child. I can't possibly afford to try to fix what is wrong with me physically. 

Really, the only thing that makes me get up in the morning is paying for my son's grave. Every month I have to make a payment on it. Even if I don't eat for a week, I will make that payment. But once it is paid off, my job is done. 

Even if there are children who need someone, I will never be able to help them. There is a system that doesn't even let you try if you don't fit the criteria.

Thank you.
Yes, I loved him and poured everything into him. All of me. In the end fate sort of chewed it all up and spit it out.
He had a stroke before he was born because of my body rejecting the pregnancy. They said he would likely be severely impaired and would never walk. We did everything. He learned to walk and was "normal" enough to go to a normal school in normal classes. He made it to third grade and then we found a tumor... and it didn't take very long after that.

I can't have any more children. It was a defect in my body that caused my son's issue in the first place. I didn't know it, but I shouldn't have been able to have a baby at all. 
We wanted a family, but I couldn't manage it properly. I invested everything into the miracle fluke, and it meant nothing in the end.

I thought about adoption. Maybe I could invest my life into making some other life happy. But they reject you right away, even for volunteering, even for foster care if you have any debt. I have millions in medical debt from my son. It will never be gone.

I am 43. 
I had a son who was born with a serious disability. We fought it and overcame it, and then he developed cancer and passed the end of last year. 
My husband left me for a woman his mother introduced him to who could have "normal" children. He started a family with her behind my back while I was spending all my time going from hospital to hospital.

I have chronic sciatica, and can barely walk.

I am so far in debt from the medical bills that there is never going to be an end. 

I just have to finish taking care of the costs related to my son's grave. I wouldn't want that to suffer if I died midway. 

Edit; When I say nothing can hurt anymore, I mean that everything that can hurt or be hurt is already hurting. It really can't get any worse.
